description: This Java class `ConvertChargeDataToSpecificChargeData` provides static utility methods to convert general `ChargeData` objects into specific charge data types used within the project, namely `SavingsAccountChargeData` and `ShareAccountChargeData`. It defines conversion methods that instantiate these data objects with default values and data extracted from the input `ChargeData`.

classes.name: ConvertChargeDataToSpecificChargeData
classes.description: Utility class for converting a general ChargeData object into specific charge data objects for savings and share accounts.

methods.name: toSavingsAccountChargeData
methods.description: Converts a ChargeData object into a SavingsAccountChargeData object with default and derived values.

methods.name: toShareAccountChargeData
methods.description: Converts a ChargeData object into a ShareAccountChargeData object with default and derived values.
